build.help: The whole build: fetch, compile, generate, package, install, zip.

bundle.help: Zip the bundle, now carrying cleon, into a publishable archive.

compile.help: Compile the model plugins, so the generator can load their Java functions.

fetch-bundle.help: Pull the asbundle bundle for this host from the registry and unpack it.

generate-sources.help: Run Actifsource headless: generate the plugin sources, features and update site, then validate.

install-features.help: Install the freshly built cleon features into the bundle's Eclipse.

package.help: Compile, jar the plugins and features, and publish the P2 update site.

all.help: Run build then deploy up end to end (the build->up dependency plan).

install.help: Extract the packaged cleon bundle into a directory on this machine.

up.help: Deploy the product to the target environment (placeholder).

publish.help: Push the combined cleon+Actifsource bundle to the registry.

publish-asset.help: Attach the built bundle to the GitHub release for this version (mechanics: the kernel's release:asset).

publish-updatesite.help: Push the P2 update site to the registry (mechanics: the kernel's release:artifact).

completion.help: Regenerate the product's shell completion from its manifest (--check reports drift and writes nothing).

install.help: Provision the host tooling the kernel needs - today oras; idempotent.

site.help: Build the product's documentation website with Hugo, in Docker (HTML only).

auth-scopes.help: Grant the stored gh token the package scopes GHCR needs (interactive, idempotent).

prune-branches.help: Delete local branches already merged into main (squash-aware via gh).

submodules.help: git submodule update --init lib/platform (init the submodule a fresh worktree needs).

catalogue.help: List the task coordinates the delivery kernel offers, marking the namespaces this product's commands reach.

generate.help: Regenerate the product's CLI module from its manifest (--check reports drift and writes nothing).
